# Description
Given a disease RNA data analysis and a list of drug DGEs, `DichotomicDrugRepurposeCore` computes the
 connectivity score between the disease and the drugs.

This class composes the classes `DichotomicDGE` and `BinChenDiseaseDGEDrugListConnectivityScore`
 through `DichotomicDrugRepurposeCore` class.

RNA data must be on the "normal distribution", usually data from microarray like analysis.

For RNA data on negative binomial distribution like Illumina RNA-Seq see `DichotomicVoomDrugRepurpose`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DrugRepurposing)
```
```{r}
library(DrugRepurposing)
rna_data <- matrix(
  c(
    6.930737, 6.643856, 5.247928, 7.169925, 7.303781, 6.375039, 6.108524, 7.055282,
    6.554589, 6.741467, 7.721099, 6.247928, 7.139551, 6.569856, 5.554589, 6.392317,
    6.643856, 5.392317, 7.348728, 7.491853, 6.044394, 5.700440, 6.169925, 5.247928,
    5.954196, 6.672425, 6.614710, 5.169925, 6.988685, 7.357552, 6.954196, 6.285402
  ),
  nrow = 8,
  ncol = 4,
  dimnames = list(
    c(780, 7849, 2049, 2101, 8717, 10594, 826, 11224),
    c("GSM1", "GSM2", "GSM3", "GSM4")
  )
)

# rna_data =
# GeneID   GSM1        GSM2        GSM3        GSM4
# 1        6.930737    6.554589    6.643856    5.954196
# 2        6.643856    6.741467    5.392317    6.672425
# 3        5.247928    7.721099    7.348728    6.614710
# 9        7.169925    6.247928    7.491853    5.169925
# 10       7.303781    7.139551    6.044394    6.988685
# 11       6.375039    6.569856    5.700440    7.357552
# 12       6.108524    5.554589    6.169925    6.954196
# 13       7.055282    6.392317    5.247928    6.285402


sample_01_map <- "1X01"

# How the map is applied:
#           1      X      0      1
# GeneID   GSM1   GSM2   GSM3   GSM4
# 1        262    116    111    162
# ...
#
#
# GSM1, GSM4 = IPF; GSM3 = control; GSM2 = excluded

drugs <- data.frame(
  name = c("A-23187", "A-443644", "AG-490", "AG-494"),
  filename = c("A-23187", "A-443644", "AG-490", "AG-494")
)

A_23187_drug <- data.frame(
  gene_id = c(780, 7849, 2049, 2101, 8717, 10594, 826, 11224),
  estimate = c(1.98564, -1.51579, 0.33099, -0.935718, -3.818529,
               1.848352, -4.332752, 3.591474)
)

A_443644_drug <- data.frame(
  gene_id = c(780, 7849, 2049, 2101, 8717, 10594, 826, 11224),
  estimate = c(-1.55774, -4.4155, 1.21015, 4.8705936, -0.1259465,
               -2.6003531, -0.3530122, -3.5426363)
)

AG_490_drug <- data.frame(
  gene_id = c(780, 7849, 2049, 2101, 8717, 10594, 826, 11224),
  estimate = c(-1.35143, 0.58724, -1.31592, 0.22267776, -0.45726445,
               -2.80993289, -0.05550198, 1.76931022)
)

AG_494_drug <- data.frame(
  gene_id = c(780, 7849, 2049, 2101, 8717, 10594, 826, 11224),
  estimate = c(-3.43357, -0.14896, 0.90733, 3.084164, -2.594041,
               4.304979, -4.944015, -2.075178)
)

drugs_rna_data <- list()
drugs_rna_data[["A-23187"]] <- A_23187_drug
drugs_rna_data[["A-443644"]] <- A_443644_drug
drugs_rna_data[["AG-490"]] <- AG_490_drug
drugs_rna_data[["AG-494"]] <- AG_494_drug


EasyDrugSignatureLoader <- R6Class(
  "EasyDrugSignatureLoader",
  inherit = DrugSignatureLoaderAbstract,
  public = list(
    initialize = function(drugs_rna_data) {
      private$drugs_rna_data <- drugs_rna_data
    },
    load = function(drug_name) {
      return(private$drugs_rna_data[[drug_name]])
    }
  ),
  private = list(
    drugs_rna_data = NA
  )
)

meanThresholdGeneFilter <- MeanThresholdGeneFilter$new(1)
easyDrugSignatureLoader <- EasyDrugSignatureLoader$new(drugs_rna_data)

drugs_genes <- c(780, 7849, 2049, 2101, 8717, 10594, 826, 11224)

dichotomicDrugRepurpose <- DichotomicDrugRepurpose$new(
  geneFilter = meanThresholdGeneFilter,
  drugSignatureLoader = easyDrugSignatureLoader
)
dichotomicDrugRepurpose$compute(
  rna_data = rna_data,
  sample_01_map = sample_01_map,
  drugs = drugs,
  drugs_genes = drugs_genes,
  random_distribution_size = 10, # 10 is a poor value used only to speed up
                                 # computation; an appropriate value is 10^5
  disease_name = "IPF",
  filter_by_protein_coding = FALSE,
  parallel_computation = FALSE,
  signature_mapper_parameter = 8
)
```
